title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
description: Ten named McMinnville campus spaces for studying, gathering, creating, reflecting and seeing student work, verified through current Linfield sources.

cards.title: Settle In at Nicholson Library
cards.subtitle: Long study windows and research help on the McMinnville campus
cards.notes: Bring focused work here during academic terms; students can use the library until midnight Sunday through Thursday.
cards.short_summary: A dependable study base with extended student hours and librarian support.
cards.evidence_claim: Linfield lists Nicholson Library at 900 SE Baker Street, provides research help there and posts academic-term student hours extending to midnight Sunday through Thursday.
cards.access_notes: Academic-term student hours are Monday-Thursday 7:30 a.m.-midnight, Friday 7:30 a.m.-6 p.m., Saturday 10 a.m.-4 p.m. and Sunday noon-midnight; hours may change.

cards.title: Meet Up in the FML
cards.subtitle: The activity-and-gathering lounge beside Starbucks in Riley Campus Center
cards.notes: Use the lounge as an easy meetup point before an event; Linfield says campus activities and gatherings take place here.
cards.short_summary: A centrally located Riley lounge built into the rhythm of campus gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: Linfield’s current campus-life glossary identifies Fred Meyer Lounge in Riley Campus Center beside Starbucks and states that many activities and gatherings take place there.
cards.access_notes: Located in Riley Campus Center; the source does not publish standalone lounge hours or public-access terms.

cards.title: Take a Game Break in Riley
cards.subtitle: A third-floor room where students play and gather
cards.notes: Head to Riley’s third floor for a social break between commitments; bring friends or check whether others are playing.
cards.short_summary: A named student gathering room with games at the center of campus life.
cards.evidence_claim: Linfield’s campus-life glossary places the game room on the third floor of Riley Campus Center and describes it as a place where students can play games and gather.
cards.access_notes: Located on Riley Campus Center’s third floor; current room hours and equipment availability are not stated.

cards.title: Find a Quiet Pause in Riley
cards.subtitle: A second-floor reflection space open to all students and faith traditions
cards.notes: Step into this room for prayer or quiet reflection, and keep the space calm for students arriving after you.
cards.short_summary: An inclusive campus room reserved for contemplation rather than conversation.
cards.evidence_claim: Linfield’s campus-life glossary identifies a prayer and meditation room on Riley Campus Center’s second floor that is available to all students and all faith traditions.
cards.access_notes: Available to Linfield students on Riley’s second floor; standalone hours and reservation rules are not published on the cited page.

cards.title: Use the IM Field Beyond Intramurals
cards.subtitle: The activity field in front of Jane Failing Hall
cards.notes: Check campus programming before heading over; the field supports student activities as well as intramural sports.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor activity ground whose campus role extends beyond scheduled intramurals.
cards.evidence_claim: Linfield’s campus-life glossary locates the IM Field in front of Jane Failing Hall and says it is used for many student activities in addition to intramural sports.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor field use may be affected by scheduled activities, athletics and weather; the cited page gives no open-use hours.

cards.title: Look for Gatherings Below Ice Auditorium
cards.subtitle: A large event and meeting room in Melrose Hall’s garden level
cards.notes: Check event listings for workshops and campus conversations here; enter Melrose Hall and look beneath Ice Auditorium.
cards.short_summary: A flexible downstairs hall used for meetings, events and group programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Linfield’s campus-life glossary describes Jonasson Hall as a large room on Melrose Hall’s garden level, below Ice Auditorium, used for events, meetings and gatherings.
cards.access_notes: Access depends on Melrose Hall operations and individual events; the source does not describe Jonasson Hall as continuously open.

cards.title: See What Is Showing at the Gallery
cards.subtitle: Rotating artist and student exhibitions in Miller Fine Arts Center
cards.notes: Drop in during posted gallery hours, then check the current-exhibit section for artist talks, residencies or student work.
cards.short_summary: A campus exhibition space where professional and student practices meet.
cards.evidence_claim: Linfield describes its Art Gallery as a learning laboratory presenting solo and group shows by recognized, emerging and student artists; exhibits are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours are Monday-Friday 9 a.m.-5 p.m. and Saturday noon-5 p.m.; the gallery is in Miller Fine Arts Center, Building B.

cards.title: Read the Cases in Walker Hall
cards.subtitle: Student-curated cultural exhibits across Walker Hall’s first floor
cards.notes: Walk the first-floor cases slowly and compare displays across the hall; exhibits change twice each year.
cards.short_summary: A self-guided museum experience woven directly into an academic building.
cards.evidence_claim: Linfield states that Anthropology Museum cases occupy Walker Hall’s first floor, change twice yearly and include individual and course-based student-curated exhibits.
cards.access_notes: Self-guided visits are Monday-Friday 8 a.m.-5 p.m.; admission is free.

cards.title: Connect at the Multicultural Center
cards.subtitle: A Withnell Commons venue for cultural programs and student connection
cards.notes: Watch campus event notices for receptions and cultural programs here; some activities also use the center’s patio.
cards.short_summary: A named campus setting for programs centered on culture, identity and connection.
cards.evidence_claim: Linfield’s current campus map places the Multicultural Center in Withnell Commons, while Linfield reporting documents student and community cultural programming held there.
cards.access_notes: Located in Withnell Commons; the cited map does not provide regular hours, eligibility rules or event-specific access details.

cards.title: Find Student Media in Renshaw Hall
cards.subtitle: The campus home named for student media work
cards.notes: Go to Renshaw when connecting with student publications or media projects, and confirm staff availability before visiting.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated campus destination for student-led media activity.
cards.evidence_claim: Linfield’s current McMinnville campus map identifies the Student Media Center inside Renshaw Hall alongside Journalism and Media Studies.
cards.access_notes: Located in Renshaw Hall; the campus map does not establish drop-in hours or unrestricted access, so confirm before visiting.
